content: Ransyeran kove raura seo Amisye Aijo Apa kove rai
Ransyeran Masmur. Nto irati akari po vatano matayao ukiny maugavo ransyerane rai ai. Ukinyo rai, wo itari

content.text: Reamare Amisye winaemeno reansai muno Nyo kove raugaje reansai,
Wirati vatano mine tename so wo Nya mbekere raen,
muno susye kotar tenambe wo raen, Winyirati Nyo mapaya kakai rai.
Amisy, reamare susye kotare wo kove raura seo Winai,
reamare susye tenambe wo kove raura seo Winai.
Reamare vatan tenambe mine so manayanambe muno ukiny mananibe.
Weye Winyi mbe akarive susye kotare mai tenambe mamaisyo Nya moyare rai,
muno Nyo vatan tenambe mine so maugavo mavabe.
Amisy, reamare susye kotare wo kove raura seo Winai,
reamare susye tenambe wo kove raura seo Winai.
Kopa so mo ama anare ntuna raije ama ine rauguje to,
Amisy, Opirati wama Amisy, Po kove raugaje wansai to.
Amisye Po kove raugaje wansai to;
koveamo susyo ntuna no mine tename so ubeaje Ai.
